title: OAKINK2: A Dataset of Bimanual Hands-Object Manipulation in Complex Task Completion

layout.note: A 2 by 3 grid of grey-framed titled panels with a rounded black title box (the dataset logo) overlapping the middle of the grid, and a full-width strip of three tinted bands under the bottom row that names the levels (Affordance, Primitive Task, Complex Task) with grey block arrows between them. The top row is the collection process; the bottom row shows the levels of abstraction.

lesson: Give a dataset figure two rows with one job each: the top row follows one real task through the collection stages (instruction, demonstration, annotation) and the bottom row shows the levels of abstraction with a tinted band strip beneath naming each level; a logo box in the middle ties them together.
